podcast.title: Cameo on Last Man Standing (2015)
podcast.body: More than 17 years after *Home Improvement* ended, she made a cameo appearance on *Last Man Standing*, starring Tim Allen and Jonathan Taylor Thomas. "Jonathan Taylor Thomas, and Patricia Richardson, made cameo appearances in an episode which also featured other nods to home improvement."
